title: Resend returns 403 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address'
symptoms: 403 validation_error: You can only send testing emails to your own email address
Sends to the account owner work, every other recipient fails
Works in a teammate's account but not in production
cause: Until a domain is verified, the account can only send to the email address that owns it. The shared resend.dev sender does not lift that restriction.
fix: Verify a domain and send from an address on it. For automated tests, send to the resend.dev test inboxes instead of real or made-up addresses.
affected: Resend API, accounts with no verified domain, as of 2026-10
